title: The 1859 storm in 30 seconds
subject: space weather
native_material: Carrington's 1859 drawing, telegraph lines, auroras, solar storm records
hook_mechanism: the viewer guesses what Carrington's 1859 drawing broke, then what it would break today
metaphors: the viewer's own guess, asked twice: 1859 and today

pick.owner_words: "Live Viewer Trap" (re-pitched after gate 1 stopped the first pitch, whose third option was not a house engine; Reverse Autopsy excluded as the last piece's engine; Trojan Horse flagged as retired for samples)

concept.logline: The worst solar storm on record, and the one that missed us in 2012.
concept.central_question: What would the 1859 storm do today?
concept.claim: In 1859 a solar storm set telegraph offices on fire; in 2012 a storm as strong missed Earth by about a week.
